Unlike previous discrete strategies, this approach directly works with real-valued functions. The main advantages are: (1) the optimization landscape is proven continuous, better than noisy discrete representations (2) we can use gradient-based methods for local refinement without getting trapped in discrete choose-which-pixel moves.
